title: The gates open for local trials
body: The Realm is being tested on a single machine before any public opening. Expect resets, rough edges and a crown that changes hands often.

title: Houses and oaths
body: Found a house, choose a sigil and swear fealty to a liege. Breaking an oath is recorded in the Chronicle for all to read.

title: Rebellion has rules
body: A rebellion must be declared and may only be fought inside its scheduled window. Ransoms are capped. The crown rules with a council, not alone.
